name: Artwork Annotation Analysis
description:
Create an annotated visual analysis of 'The Great Wave off Kanagawa' in ActivInspire.

Your task is to create a 3-page flipchart saved as '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/artwork_analysis.flipchart':

1. **Page 1 (Title)**: Import the image 'great_wave.jpg' (located in /home/ga/Pictures/ActivInspire/) and add the title 'The Great Wave off Kanagawa' and artist 'Hokusai'.

2. **Page 2 (Composition)**: Place the image again. Add at least 3 arrows or lines pointing to specific parts of the wave, foreground, or background. Add text labels for 'foreground', 'background', and 'wave'.

3. **Page 3 (Elements of Art)**: Add the title 'Elements of Art'. Write notes analyzing the work using at least 3 of these terms: line, color, shape, texture, contrast, movement.

Note: The image file is already downloaded to your Pictures folder.
